feature_area: Channel Info panel (Info RHS) - opened via channel header button 'View Info' or channel menu item 'View Info'

target_release.note: Pinned checkout is master (version 12.2.0, unreleased). Both selected scenarios were re-checked against v12.1.0 source; see coverage.md 'Release pin'.

scenarios.title: Open Info panel follows the newly selected channel after a sidebar channel switch
techniques: equivalence partitioning (seeded distinct value classes per channel)
scenarios.risk_behavior_under_test: Stale-panel regression. The Info RHS keeps rhsState=CHANNEL_INFO and a selectedChannelId captured when it was opened (actions/views/rhs.ts:524-530, reducers/views/rhs.ts:107), but renders getCurrentChannel (channel_info_rhs/index.ts:39). switchToChannel re-targets the Pinned and Files RHS views to the new channel (actions/global_actions.tsx:88, :92) but does nothing for Info, and SidebarRight does not close the RHS on a same-team channel change (sidebar_right.tsx:240-253). The panel content following the new channel therefore depends on an implicit coupling that no e2e test pins down. A regression would show channel A's purpose/header/handle while the user is in channel B.

closest_cypress.asserts: From the Members sub-view, switching to a DM leaves the RHS title 'Info' visible (:111). Asserts only the static title text.
Open via #channel-info-btn; helper :536-541 checks 'Info' and the subtitle contains the display name, for a single channel, no transition.
Purpose patched via API while the panel is open appears in the RHS (single channel, live update).
Header patched via API appears in the RHS (single channel).

closest_playwright.asserts: MM-T880: header saved via intro modal is visible in the Info RHS opened from channel menu 'View Info' (:89-94). Single channel.
Name, purpose, handle, ID for one channel; mute; settings modal. No channel switch.

scenarios.remaining_gap: No test opens Info on channel A, switches in-app to channel B, and asserts that the panel now shows B's display name/purpose/header/handle AND no longer shows A's values. CY-32 starts from a different RHS state (Members), lands on a DM (different about-area component, about_area_dm.tsx), and checks only the constant title 'Info', which would pass even if the content were stale.

negative_control.change: Swap the seeded purpose and header strings between qa-sandbox and release-planning (names, display names, URLs, membership and view-state unchanged).
negative_control.expected_effect: Navigation and both clicks still succeed; post-switch toContainText 'Release purpose bravo-91d2' fails and not.toContainText 'Sandbox purpose alpha-7f3c' fails. Pre-switch also fails, proving the pre-switch checkpoint is seed-bound.

risks_of_flakiness: Sidebar link name gains ' unread' if release-planning has unseen posts; mitigated by the final view call and no later posts. Engine must not fall back to a regex.
Center channel header also renders 'Release header bravo-91d2'; every text assertion must be scoped to region 'Info'.
The about area and subtitle render from Redux immediately, but use auto-waiting expect (default 5s+) rather than snapshot timing.
Onboarding tours can cover the sidebar for a new user; mitigated by the four seeded preferences.
If a future build closes the RHS on channel switch, the test fails on 'region Info visible'; that is a product change to be triaged, not flake.

scenarios.title: Archived public channel: Info panel shows the archived notice and is read-only for a regular member
techniques: decision table (channel type x archived x role/permission x content present)
equivalence partitioning (archived vs active public channel)
scenarios.risk_behavior_under_test: Authorization/UX gating driven by real server state. After a channel is archived (delete_at != 0 from the server), the panel must show 'This channel is archived.', must hide Add People, every Edit affordance (rename, purpose, header), Notification Preferences and Channel Settings, must NOT offer 'Unarchive' to a user without manage_team, and must still show the seeded purpose/header read-only. Currently only Jest unit tests with mocked props cover this (channel_info_rhs.test.tsx:74, menu.test.tsx:98, :291); no e2e test opens Info on an archived channel.

closest_cypress.asserts: MM-T1717: after archiving, the channel header DROPDOWN hides Archive, Channel Settings and Notification Preferences and keeps Members. Does not open the Info RHS.
Add People absent in the Info RHS for a user whose channel_user role lost manage_*_members (permission cause, active channel). Does not check Edit, notice or menu items.
Channel menu lists 'View Info' (and others) for an active channel.

closest_playwright.asserts: Archives (:316) then unarchives (:326) a channel as setup only; Info is opened on the ACTIVE channel to check attribute locking.

scenarios.remaining_gap: No test (main or open PR) opens the Info RHS on an archived channel. The archived-notice text, the absence of Add People/Edit/Notification Preferences/Channel Settings in the panel, the absence of Unarchive for a non-team-admin, and the preservation of read-only purpose/header are unproven end-to-end. CY-33 proves the analogous gating only for the header dropdown, a different component (channel_header_menu).

fixture_setup.server: Same server and users as PILOT-01.
ordering_requirements: As qa-admin: create channel, add qa-user, patch purpose/header, THEN archive with DELETE /api/v4/channels/{channel_id}.
Verify GET /api/v4/channels/{channel_id} returns delete_at > 0 before writing storageState.
fixture_setup.permissions: Defaults. qa-user is team_user (no manage_team: only team_admin has it, role.go:1080-1086) and channel_user (has manage_public_channel_members/properties, role.go:974,979, so only the archived state can explain their absence).
fixture_setup.config_feature_flags: None. Viewing archived channels is always allowed since MM-63240 (commit c8d6630141, ancestor of v12.1.0).

risks_of_flakiness: A count-0 assertion passes vacuously if the panel has not rendered; always assert the region and the notice text are visible BEFORE any count-0 check.
